question: Does the current focused-task selector improve learning efficiency relative to the repository's prior opportunistic task choice?
action: Inspected durable evidence only (no research code executed; tests_preceding_process=false). Read state/LEARNING_STATE.md (active strategy delta, frontier table, recent learning history, Next), state/STATE.md, state/worker_progress.md, state/campaign/task_queue.json, state/campaign/current_task.json, and the controller-side records in state/campaign/runs/46128217530/: campaign_status.json, task_queue_initial.json, agents/agent_01.json, agents/agent_01_validation.json, agents/agent_02.json, agents/agent_02_invalid_record.json, agents/agent_02_validation.json, agents/agent_03_contract.json, agents/agent_03_before.json, and quarantine/agent_02/{failure_reasons.json,status.txt}. Compared the documented pre-frontier opportunistic-selection period against the post-frontier-first closed-cell sequence, then audited the current campaign-level selector using the agent 01/02/03 selection records.
changed: state/worker_progress.md (semantic milestone: P-001 completed by agent 03)
verified: Duplicate task assignment (controller-side): campaign_status.json selected_tasks and selection_history both record agent 1 -> P-001, agent 2 -> R-001, agent 3 -> P-001; agent_01_validation.json status=VERIFIED_SESSION with failures=[]; agent_01.json is a complete P-001 answer (decision RETAIN). The identical task was therefore already completed and controller-validated before agent 03 was assigned it.

Queue mechanism for the duplicate: task_queue.json P-001 status=SELECTED (selected_agent 3), not COMPLETED, and the schema keeps only a single latest selected_agent per task, so a consumed/completed task is not excluded from later selection.

Record-loss path (controller-side): agent_02_validation.json failures contains exactly one item, 'candidate_task_0_invalid:task missing fields: [verifiability, tests_preceding_process]'; status=UNVERIFIED_SESSION; warnings include 'invalid_agent_record_replaced_with_UNVERIFIED_fallback'; quarantine.moved_untracked lists research/checks/momentum_cost_sensitivity.py, research/checks/verify_momentum_cost_sensitivity.py, state/check_artifacts/momentum_cost_sensitivity_results.json.

The discarded work was substantive and self-verified: agent_02_invalid_record.json documents a completed COST-ROBUST classification (lookback 3/5/10 x zero/realistic/conservative costs, matched null, 3-gate independent verifier, 168/168 regression tests, a-priori erosion prediction FALSIFIED).

The discarded result is absent from durable state: state/LEARNING_STATE.md line 13 (Next) still instructs a fresh activation to run the conservative transaction-cost test, and the frontier table contains no cost-robustness row; state/check_artifacts/ (per agent_03_before.json hashes) contains no momentum_cost_sensitivity_results.json (it exists only under quarantine/agent_02/).

Research-level frontier-first delta remains supported: LEARNING_STATE.md lines 12 and 53-59 record five genuinely distinct signal-class cells closed decisively with independent verification and no equivalent re-test (mean-reversion 37263008074, cross-sectional relative strength 37304873966, volatility targeting 37314710995, momentum 37318950814, 20-day breakout 37414038601); momentum lookback (37361000967) and longer-horizon (37394344201) are distinct qualifications, not equivalent retests. This corroborates the contract evidence_basis and agent_01.json.
No protected paths were modified (.github/**, .kilo/**, AGENTS.md, ENTERPRISE.md, MANUAL_SETUP.md, PERSISTENCE_POLICY.md); no research code was run and none was required for this process audit.
unverified: Exact activation finish timestamp: no clock is available at this layer; only the controller start reference 2026-11-28T09:10:59Z (agent_03_before.json captured_utc) and the message time 2026-11-28T09:11:05Z are available. Not backfilled.
Counterfactual: what a consumed-task-aware selector would have assigned to agent 03 instead of the duplicate P-001 is unobservable, so the efficiency loss from the duplicate is not quantified.
Generality: run 46128217530 contains only three selections; the duplicate-assignment defect is verified for this instance but is not shown to be systematic across campaigns.
Recurrence: whether the candidate_task-schema record-loss path discards valid primary research in other runs is unobservable from this single instance.

Attribution: the research-level frontier-first advantage is confounded by the research framework reaching full gate maturity (perturbation, regime, universe, leakage, independent verifiers), so it cannot be attributed to selection alone.
observed_effect: The campaign-level focused-task selector did NOT improve learning efficiency in this run: it re-assigned P-001 to agent 03 after agent 01 had already completed and controller-validated the identical task (duplicate assignment; the queue tracks only the latest selected_agent and does not exclude consumed tasks). Separately, agent 02's completed, independently verified COST-ROBUST research was discarded from durable state because a SECONDARY candidate_task (R-006) omitted two required schema fields, and its three artifacts were quarantined. The research-level frontier-first delta remains supported (five distinct cells closed decisively with independent verification and no equivalent retests). Net: a verified negative for the campaign-level selector, no process redesign (out of scope), and two minimal candidate tasks recorded.
uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection improves learning efficiency relative to the repository's prior opportunistic queue-based task choice.
uncertainty_reduced: The durable record now separates three things that were previously conflated: (a) the SUPPORTED research-level frontier-first advantage (five decisive, independently verified, non-duplicative cell closures); (b) a VERIFIED campaign-level selector defect (duplicate assignment of an already-validated task, with the queue mechanism identified); and (c) a VERIFIED record-loss path (a secondary candidate_task schema defect causes the controller to discard a valid primary deliverable and quarantine verified research). Both (b) and (c) are recorded with controller-side evidence and converted into two minimal candidate tasks so later agents and the final synthesis do not re-litigate or overclaim. The disagreement with agent_01's IMPROVED observation is preserved explicitly.
research_result: LEARNING_PROCESS judgment (not a market/financial result). RETAIN the frontier-first focused-task selection at the research level: the durable evidence (LEARNING_STATE.md lines 12, 53-59; corroborated by agent_01.json) shows five genuinely distinct signal-class cells each closed decisively with independent verification and no equivalent re-test, and the first positive candidate (momentum) was surfaced. However, the CURRENT CAMPAIGN-LEVEL selector does not demonstrate an efficiency advantage and exhibits one verified defect in run 46128217530: it assigned the already-completed, controller-validated task P-001 to agent 03 (duplicate assignment; task_queue.json keeps only the latest selected_agent and never marks P-001 COMPLETED). A second verified process leak was found: agent 02's completed COST-ROBUST research (3-gate verifier, 168/168 tests, a-priori prediction falsified) was discarded and quarantined solely because a secondary candidate_task (R-006) omitted the required fields verifiability and tests_preceding_process, so a valid primary deliverable was lost from durable state (LEARNING_STATE.md Next still lists the cost test as pending). Because the contract's out_of_scope forbids redesigning the controller architecture or adding a reward score, no process change is made here; the two defects are recorded as minimal candidate tasks (P-007 consumed-task exclusion, P-008 candidate_task-schema record-loss). This is a VERIFIED_NEGATIVE_RESULT for the campaign-level selector claim, bounded to n=3 selections, and it does not overturn the research-level RETAIN.
next: At final campaign synthesis, verify whether the duplicate P-001 assignment (agents 01 and 03) and the agent-02 candidate_task-schema record-loss are the only selector/validation defects in run 46128217530, and record whether a minimal consumed-task exclusion (P-007) and a candidate_task-schema repair (P-008) are warranted.
